Martin J. C. Woo, age about 42, native of
Shanghai, is a graduate of the Ellis Kadoorie
School, formerly located at No. 1 Shanhaikwan Road.
He is the brother-in-law of Sung Fu-lun(沈甫),
who is the son of the late Sung Chung-li(沈仲礼),
Director of the Red Cross Hospital, Avenue Haig.

Following the death of Sung Chung Li, Fu Siao-en,
the late Mayor of Shanghai in the Wang Ching Wei Regime
(assassinated in October, 1940), was entrusted with the
task of liquidating the estate of Sung Chung-li, Sung
and Fu being sworn brothers. It was through this
business that Fu Siao-en fell in love and cohabited
with the 5th concubine of Sung Chung-li, and through
this love affair, Sung Fu-lun, son of the late Sung
Chung-li, became the adopted son of the late Mayor.

Martin J. C. Woo later became related to the
late Mayor Fu Siao-en as a result of Woo's younger
sister being married to Fu's adopted son, Sung Fu-lun
The relationship, it was reported, was further tightened
by the marked intimacy between Woo's wife and the late
Mayor, who, it was also learnt, was not on cordial
terms with his own son, Fu Ping-kwei (傅品圭 ).

Nothing of significance transpired in the early
life of Martin J. C. Woo. He was a member of the
local Boyscouts and Shanghai Volunteer Corps, and was
once employed as a secretary in the Commercial Bank
of China, The Bund, when the late Mayor Fu was the
director and General Manager. Acting in the role
of a personal attendant to Fu, Martin Woo often led
the latter to questionable amusements. When the late

Martin J. C. Woo 吳吉卿 8/3
28 1+ 41

X 另见 N 13(C) 及

Martin J. C. Woo，约42岁，上海人，毕业于埃利斯·卡杜里学校（Ellis Kadoorie School），该校原址位于山海关路1号。他是沈甫（Sung Fu-lun）的姐夫，沈甫是已故海格路红十字会医院院长沈仲礼（Sung Chung-li）之子。

沈仲礼去世后，汪精卫政权下的已故上海市长傅筱庵（Fu Siao-en，于1940年10月遇刺身亡）受托负责清算沈仲礼的遗产，因沈、傅二人曾结为异姓兄弟。正是在处理此事的过程中，傅筱庵与沈仲礼的五姨太产生恋情并同居；通过这段恋情，已故沈仲礼之子沈甫成为了已故市长的养子。

后来，由于吴的妹妹嫁给了傅的养子沈甫，Martin J. C. Woo 便与已故市长傅筱庵建立了亲属关系。据报，吴的妻子与已故市长之间关系极为亲密，这使得上述亲属关系进一步紧密；此外还获悉，已故市长与其亲生儿子傅品圭（Fu Ping-kwei）关系不和。

Martin J. C. Woo 的早年生活中并无重大事件发生。他曾是本地童子军和上海万国商团的成员，并曾在外滩的中国银行担任秘书，当时已故市长傅筱庵正担任该行的董事兼总经理。吴以傅的私人随从身份行事，经常带领后者参与一些不正当的娱乐活动。当已故

Mayor resigned from the Commercial Bank of China
and took refuge in Dairen in 1927, being wanted by
the Nationalist Government on a charge of affording
the Northern rebels facilities in military transport
by China Merchants steamships, Martin Woo remained
in Shanghai for sometime and then joined Fu in
Dairen. They returned to Shanghai together in
1936 when Fu resumed directorship of the Commercial
Bank of China.
When Fu Siao-en was appointed Mayor of
Shanghai in October, 1938 through the efforts of
Major General Doihara, Martin Woo was appointed by
Fu to the post of Superintendent of the Shanghai
City Government on January 7, 1939 and promoted to
the post of Special Delegate on June 2, 1939. He
remained in the latter position until shortly after
the assassination of Mayor Fu in October, 1940.
Nothing was afterwards heard of him until
about a month ago when he joined the Ministry of
Social Affairs, Nanking as a Special Delegate. He
is now attached to the Shanghai Branch, Social
Movement Direction Committee, 527 Route Road, in that
capacity.

市长于1927年辞去中国银行职务并逃往大连时，因被国民政府通缉，罪名是利用招商局轮船为北方叛军提供军事运输便利，Martin Woo 在上海停留了一段时间后，前往大连与傅会合。1936年，当傅复任中国银行董事时，他们一同返回上海。

1938年10月，在土肥原贤二少将（Major General Doihara）的运作下，傅筱庵被任命为上海市长，随后傅于1939年1月7日任命 Martin Woo 为上海市政府督察长，并于1939年6月2日将其晋升为特派员。他一直担任后一职务，直至1940年10月傅市长遇刺后不久。

此后直到大约一个月前，一直未有关于他的消息，当时他加入南京国民政府社会部，担任特派员。目前，他以该身份隶属于位于鲁特路527号的社会运动指导委员会上海分会。
